body: The hot air wafts from the open ovens, mingling with the sweet scent of freshly baked croissants. I feel a shiver run down my spine as I scan the empty bakery, my mind racing with worst-case scenarios. My eyes dart around the dimly lit room, each creaking floorboard and flickering light source seeming to echo my growing unease. Every step feels like a betrayal, as if I'm leading myself further into danger.
